proposal.summary: Marval MSM v14.19.0.12476 is vulnerable to Cross Site Request Forgery (CSRF) that allows an attacker to disable a user's 2FA by sending the user a malicious form.

AV.quote: An attacker can disable the 2FA by sending the user a malicious form.

UI.quote: An attacker can disable the 2FA by sending the user a malicious form.

C.quote: An attacker can disable the 2FA by sending the user a malicious form.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request proof-of-concept HTTP requests or steps showing the CSRF request and whether user authentication is required; confirm affected endpoints and provide a mitigated update or recommended CSRF protections (anti-CSRF tokens, SameSite cookies).

evidence_quotes.quote: An attacker can disable the 2FA by sending the user a malicious form.
